translations.text: Oh, dear Lord! Oh, good Judge!
Help me, eternal Ruler.
I know that my soul is badly wounded by sins. Heal it, Lord of the heavens, and cure it, Prince of life, for you can do it most easily of all the physicians who have ever been, far or wide.
O bright Lord, Creator of the people!
Let your heart be merciful and kind to me; give your grace to your poor wretch.

Wretched is he who here on earth, by day and by night, fights for the devil and does his will; woe to him for that pleasure when he receives and beholds the reward for it, unless he first turns away from that evil.

Blessed is he who here on earth, by day and by night, obeys the Lord and always does his will; it will go well for him for that work when he receives and beholds the reward for it, if he comes to a wholly good end.
O Light of light! O joy of life!
Grant me, glorious King, when I pray for my soul, heaven's eternal grace. You are gracious, God; you alone hold and rule over all the earth and the heavens of the wide creation.
You alone are the true Creator over all who dwell on earth; likewise, up in the heavens, you are God the Saviour.

No man can praise you enough. Even if all of us were gathered from across the wide earth, all people on the ground, throughout the whole world, we could never declare, or truly know, how noble you are, eternal Lord.
Even if the wise hosts of angels up in the heavens began to speak together, they could never tell it, or know its measure, how glorious you are, mighty Lord.

But it is a great wonder, Ruler of angels, if you yourself know it, Prince of victory, how glorious you are, mighty and strong in power, King of all kings, living Christ, Creator of all worlds, Ruler of angels, Glory of all glories, Lord Saviour.

You are the noble one whom in days of old the joy of all women fairly bore in the city of Bethlehem, as a comfort to men and as a grace to all the children of men who believe in the living God and in the eternal light up in the heavens.
Your power is so great, mighty Lord, that no one who dwells on earth knows the depth of the Lord's might, and no one of the order of angels knows the height of the King of the heavens.
I confess to you, almighty God, that I believe in you, dear Saviour: that you are the great one and the mighty one and the humble one, the best of all, and the eternal King of all creation;

and I am the little one before you and the wicked man, who sins here very often. Day and night I do what I should not, sometimes in deed, sometimes in word, sometimes in thought; I am grievously guilty of malicious deeds, often and frequently.
But now I implore you, Lord of the heavens, and I pray to you, best of sons, that you have mercy on me, mighty Lord,
high King of the heavens, and the Holy Spirit; and help me, Father almighty, so that I may do your will before I depart from this passing life.
Do not refuse me, Lord of glory, but grant me, glorious King, to go up with the angels, to sit in heaven, and to praise the God of heaven with holy speech forever without end. Amen.
